name: segment-designer-sdk
description: Deterministic TypeScript SDK for authoring eSNG-compatible dynamic-segment UI JSON.

scripts.build: npm run clean && node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p tsconfig.json && node node_modules/esbuild/bin/esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=es2022 --sourcemap --outfile=dist/index.js
